title: Ride & Roam: Mystery Sightseeing Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
A mystery tour? What does that even mean?!
Do you want to experience some of the most “off-the-beaten-path” locations the Anchorage area has to offer? Then this tour is for you! Let your “Tour Guide to the Wild Side” take you on the most unexpected adventure you’ll find in Anchorage. Experience beautiful drives to secret glacier views or unexpected trails to cascading waterfalls. Why stick to the rivers and lakes you’re used to when you can experience something new? We never quite know where we’re going until we know where you’ve been, so we can always guarantee that you’ll see something you’ve never seen! With no group minimum, its a great opportunity for solo travelers!
You won’t get a rehearsed speech, but you will get a guide that feels like a friend and a tour customized to the needs and desires of everyone participating. Our mission is to convey our love of Alaska to you, by showing you our personal favorite places that will take your breath away! Book direct and save!
